blocks.zh: 🎓 中文學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 🎓 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解廠商評估 (Vendor Assessment) 在 C&Q 文件目的下的定義，並能區分其與商業廠商選擇/稽核的本質差異。
blocks.en: Understand how Vendor Assessment is defined for the purpose of C&Q documentation, and distinguish it from commercial vendor selection/auditing.

blocks.zh: 掌握 4 種廠商評估策略（現有評估、自評、現場 SME 評估、豁免），並能判斷何時適用豁免 (Waiver)。
blocks.en: Master the four vendor assessment strategies (existing assessment, self-assessment, on-site SME assessment, waiver) and be able to judge when a waiver applies.

blocks.zh: 解釋工程品質流程 (Engineering Quality Process) 作為 PQS 子集的定位，並能對應 FDA 六系統稽查模型。
blocks.en: Explain the position of the Engineering Quality Process as a subset of the PQS, and map it to the FDA six-system inspection model.

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q10 三大目標與戴明原則對 C&Q 哲學的影響，並能說明「品質建入」與「依賴檢驗」的差異。
blocks.en: Understand the three ICH Q10 objectives and the influence of Deming's principle on the C&Q philosophy, and explain the difference between "building quality in" and "relying on inspection".

blocks.zh: 能描述工程品質流程的文件層級 (Document Hierarchy)，並對應到 CDMO 驗證 SOP 體系的實際架構。
blocks.en: Describe the document hierarchy of the Engineering Quality Process and map it to the actual structure of a CDMO's validation SOP system.

blocks.zh: 📋 章節重點摘要 Section Summary
blocks.en: 📋 Section Summary

blocks.zh: Ch.10：廠商評估目的在於建立對廠商 QMS 的信心，使其測試文件可直接支援系統資格確認 (Qualification)，減少重複測試成本。
blocks.en: Ch.10: The purpose of vendor assessment is to build confidence in the vendor's QMS so that its test documentation can directly support system Qualification, reducing the cost of duplicate testing.

blocks.zh: Ch.10 關鍵點：評估 C&Q 文件目的之廠商，不等同於原材料廠商稽核；評估 11 項因素；4 種策略；非 GMP 廠商需 6 項額外控制；6+2 項訓練要求。
blocks.en: Ch.10 key points: Assessing a vendor for C&Q documentation purposes is not the same as auditing a raw material vendor; 11 factors are evaluated; 4 strategies; non-GMP vendors need 6 additional controls; 6+2 training requirements.

blocks.zh: Ch.11：工程品質流程 (Engineering Quality Process) 是 PQS 在 C&Q 領域的子集，強調「品質建入流程」而非「依賴末端檢驗」。
blocks.en: Ch.11: The Engineering Quality Process is the subset of the PQS applied to C&Q, emphasizing "building quality into the process" rather than "relying on end-of-line inspection".

blocks.zh: Ch.11 關鍵點：ICH Q10 三目標（產品實現、控制狀態、持續改善）；FDA 六系統模型；文件層級（政策 → 標準 → 程序 → 可執行文件）；5 個功能角色。
blocks.en: Ch.11 key points: The three ICH Q10 objectives (product realisation, state of control, continual improvement); the FDA six-system model; the document hierarchy (policy → standard → procedure → executable document); 5 functional roles.

blocks.zh: 解談 中文解析與學習重點
blocks.en: Commentary and Key Learning Points

blocks.zh: 📚 核心概念：廠商評估 (Vendor Assessment) 是什麼？
blocks.en: 📚 Core Concept: What Is Vendor Assessment?

blocks.zh: 本章所指的「廠商評估」，目的非常具體：確認廠商自行產生的測試記錄與文件是否可直接用來支援設備/系統的 Qualification（資格確認）。
blocks.en: In this chapter, the purpose of "vendor assessment" is very specific: to confirm whether the vendor's own test records and documentation can be used directly to support the Qualification of equipment/systems.

blocks.zh: 其核心問題是：「這個廠商的文件品質，足以讓我們不需要在現場再次執行全套測試嗎？」
blocks.en: The core question is: "Is the quality of this vendor's documentation good enough that we do not need to repeat the full set of tests on site?"

blocks.zh: 關鍵字翻譯：
blocks.en: Key terms:

blocks.zh: Vendor Assessment（廠商評估）= 評估廠商產出 C&Q 支援文件的能力
blocks.en: Vendor Assessment = evaluating the vendor's ability to produce documentation that supports C&Q

blocks.zh: Vendor Quality System（廠商品質系統）= 廠商的 QMS
blocks.en: Vendor Quality System = the vendor's QMS

blocks.zh: Certificate of Conformity / CoC（符合性證明）= 廠商出具的材質/規格合格聲明書
blocks.en: Certificate of Conformity / CoC = a statement issued by the vendor declaring that the material/specification requirements are met

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重要區別：這不是供應商稽核！
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key distinction: this is not a supplier audit!

blocks.zh: 很多人容易混淆兩件事：
blocks.en: Many people confuse two different things:

blocks.zh: C&Q 文件目的廠商評估（本章主題）：評估廠商能否產出符合 GDocP 的 C&Q 文件（FAT/SAT 報告、測試記錄等），讓業主不必重複做測試。
blocks.en: Vendor assessment for C&Q documentation purposes (the topic of this chapter): evaluates whether the vendor can produce C&Q documents that comply with GDocP (FAT/SAT reports, test records, etc.), so that the owner does not have to repeat the testing.

blocks.zh: 商業供應商資格確認（Vendor Qualification / Supplier Audit）：評估原料藥、輔料、包材供應商的 GMP 合規性，確保材料品質。這是完全不同的目的！
blocks.en: Commercial supplier qualification (Vendor Qualification / Supplier Audit): evaluates the GMP compliance of API, excipient and packaging material suppliers to ensure material quality. This is an entirely different purpose!

blocks.zh: 本章明確說明：C&Q 廠商評估「不包含」商業廠商選擇評估，即使兩者結果可以相互參考。
blocks.en: The chapter states explicitly that C&Q vendor assessment "does not include" commercial vendor selection assessment, even though the results of the two may inform each other.

blocks.zh: 💡 比喻：CoC 就像「產地證明」
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: a CoC is like a "certificate of origin"

blocks.zh: 試想你向一家信譽良好的不銹鋼管材廠商採購 316L 管材。如果你已評估過該廠商的 QMS 是可靠的，你可以接受他們的 CoC（符合性證明）來驗證材質，而不需要自己送 100% 的管材去做熱處理憑證查核（Heat Certificate Check）。
blocks.en: Imagine you are buying 316L tubing from a reputable stainless steel tube supplier. If you have already assessed that the supplier's QMS is reliable, you can accept their CoC (Certificate of Conformity) to verify the material, rather than sending 100% of the tubing for a heat certificate check yourself.

blocks.zh: 這就是「廠商是自己系統的專家」的精神——讓專家負責自己的工作，業主聚焦在真正的高風險項目上。
blocks.en: This reflects the principle that "vendors are the experts on their own systems": let the experts take responsibility for their own work, so the owner can focus on the items that are truly high risk.

blocks.zh: 🔎 原則/概念重點整理
blocks.en: 🔎 Summary of Principles/Concepts

blocks.zh: 是否接受廠商文件的決策依據：
blocks.en: The basis for deciding whether to accept vendor documentation:

blocks.zh: 製造系統的預期用途（intended purpose）
blocks.en: The intended purpose of the manufacturing system

blocks.zh: 廠商品質系統的適用性（suitability of vendor QMS）
blocks.en: The suitability of the vendor QMS

blocks.zh: 決策理由必須記錄於 C&Q Plan，由 SME 及 QU 核准
blocks.en: The rationale for the decision must be documented in the C&Q Plan and approved by the SME and the QU

blocks.zh: QU 監督程度是風險導向的：
blocks.en: The level of QU oversight is risk-based:

blocks.zh: 低風險：管道內窺鏡檢查 (Boroscoping)、鈍化 (Passivation) 文件
blocks.en: Low risk: pipe borescope inspection (Boroscoping) and passivation documentation

blocks.zh: 高風險：無菌充填隔離器的 SAT（Site Acceptance Testing）
blocks.en: High risk: SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) of an aseptic filling isolator

blocks.zh: 風險越高，QU 的介入程度越深——這是貫穿整個 ISPE Vol.5 的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: The higher the risk, the deeper the QU involvement. This is the core logic running through the whole of ISPE Vol.5.

blocks.zh: 📋 豁免情況
blocks.en: 📋 Waiver Situations

blocks.zh: 如果廠商提供的是「次要服務」（例如 HVAC 平衡廠商 NEBB），且合約要求其依照業主程序或適用的專業標準執行，則不需要按本章要求進行廠商評估。
blocks.en: If the vendor provides a "minor service" (for example, an HVAC balancing contractor such as NEBB) and the contract requires it to work in accordance with the owner's procedures or applicable professional standards, a vendor assessment per this chapter is not required.

blocks.zh: 💬 早期溝通是品質建入的基礎
blocks.en: 💬 Early Communication Is the Foundation of Building Quality In

blocks.zh: 本節強調：在專案早期就要對廠商清楚溝通以下五個關鍵要素，不可拖延到 FAT/SAT 前才談：
blocks.en: This section stresses that the following five key elements must be clearly communicated to the vendor early in the project, and must not be left until just before FAT/SAT:

blocks.zh: 作業範疇（Scope of Work）— 測試哪些項目？
blocks.en: Scope of Work: which items will be tested?

blocks.zh: 具體交付文件（Deliverables）— 提交什麼格式的文件？
blocks.en: Deliverables: what documents, in what format, are to be submitted?

blocks.zh: 品質保證要求（QA Requirements）— 文件需符合 GDocP
blocks.en: QA Requirements: documents must comply with GDocP

blocks.zh: 專案管控（Project Controls）— 變更如何管理？
blocks.en: Project Controls: how are changes managed?

blocks.zh: 文件時程（Schedule）— 文件審查 Lead Time 預留多少？
blocks.en: Schedule: how much lead time is allowed for document review?

blocks.zh: 💡 CDMO 採購情境類比
blocks.en: 💡 CDMO Procurement Analogy

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 正在採購一台新的無菌充填機。在簽約前，你需要在採購規格書（URS）中清楚載明：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO is purchasing a new aseptic filling machine. Before signing the contract, you need to state clearly in the purchase specification (URS):

blocks.zh: 廠商需提供哪些 FAT/SAT 測試文件
blocks.en: Which FAT/SAT test documents the vendor must provide

blocks.zh: 文件格式需符合公司的 GDocP 要求
blocks.en: That the document format must meet the company's GDocP requirements

blocks.zh: 變更通知程序（ECM）
blocks.en: The change notification procedure (ECM)

blocks.zh: 文件交付截止日期及審查周期
blocks.en: Document delivery deadlines and review cycles

blocks.zh: 這樣在廠商製造期間就有明確依據，避免交機時發現文件格式不符合要求，被迫現場補做測試。
blocks.en: This gives clear grounds during vendor manufacturing, and avoids discovering at delivery that the document format does not meet requirements, forcing testing to be repeated on site.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 實務提醒：確認「理解」不等於「已收到」
blocks.en: ⚠️ Practical reminder: confirming "understanding" is not the same as "received"

blocks.zh: 本節特別要求要確認廠商理解（Confirm Comprehension），而不只是「發送文件給廠商」。應安排說明會或書面回覆確認，並在專案時程中預留對話時間。這在跨國設備採購中尤為重要。
blocks.en: This section specifically requires that you Confirm Comprehension by the vendor, not merely "send documents to the vendor". Arrange a briefing or a written reply as confirmation, and allow time in the project schedule for these discussions. This is especially important in cross-border equipment purchases.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 延伸：供應鏈及分包商的評估
blocks.en: ⚠️ Extension: assessing the supply chain and subcontractors

blocks.zh: 本節特別提醒：除了廠商本身，還要評估廠商的供應鏈管理能力——例如廠商是否有機制評估其自己的焊接分包商、管線供應商、自動化硬體/軟體供應商。
blocks.en: This section specifically reminds us that, besides the vendor itself, the vendor's supply chain management capability should also be assessed. For example, does the vendor have a mechanism to assess its own welding subcontractors, piping suppliers, and automation hardware/software suppliers?

blocks.zh: 這在複雜設備（如隔離器、充填機）採購中尤其重要，因為廠商本身可能對許多關鍵次系統進行外包。
blocks.en: This is especially important when buying complex equipment (such as isolators and filling machines), because the vendor may outsource many critical subsystems.

blocks.zh: 🏢 CDMO 應用：採購新充填機前的廠商評估問題清單
blocks.en: 🏢 CDMO Application: Vendor Assessment Question List Before Buying a New Filling Machine

blocks.zh: 在簽署採購合約前，CDMO 採購/驗證團隊可以對設備廠商提出以下問題：
blocks.en: Before signing the purchase contract, the CDMO procurement/validation team can ask the equipment vendor the following questions:

blocks.zh: 貴公司有無同類設備（無菌充填機）交付製藥廠的記錄？（系統新穎度）
blocks.en: Does your company have a record of delivering similar equipment (aseptic filling machines) to pharmaceutical manufacturers? (system novelty)

blocks.zh: 執行 FAT/SAT 的工程師是否受過 GMP 文件訓練？（人員培訓）
blocks.en: Have the engineers who perform FAT/SAT been trained in GMP documentation? (personnel training)

blocks.zh: 測試使用的儀器是否有有效校正憑證？（校正計畫）
blocks.en: Do the instruments used for testing have valid calibration certificates? (calibration program)

blocks.zh: 貴公司如何管理設備設計或軟體的工程變更？（工程品質系統）
blocks.en: How does your company manage engineering changes to equipment design or software? (engineering quality system)

blocks.zh: FAT 文件會在幾天內提交？格式是否可以先提供範例？（文件標準）
blocks.en: Within how many days will the FAT documents be submitted? Can a sample of the format be provided in advance? (documentation standards)

blocks.zh: 關鍵焊接部分是由貴公司執行還是外包？外包商如何管控？（供應鏈）
blocks.en: Is the critical welding performed by your company or outsourced? How are subcontractors controlled? (supply chain)

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 何時可以申請豁免 (Waiver)？
blocks.en: ⚠️ When Can a Waiver Be Requested?

blocks.zh: 豁免評估必須具備以下任一合理理由，並經過 QU 核准記錄於 C&Q Plan：
blocks.en: A waiver of the assessment must be supported by any one of the following justified reasons, approved by the QU and documented in the C&Q Plan:

blocks.zh: 廠商目前的資格確認狀態仍有效
blocks.en: The vendor's current qualification status is still valid

blocks.zh: 有良好的使用歷史紀錄（過去多次合作均無問題）
blocks.en: There is a good history of use (many past engagements without problems)

blocks.zh: 有近期稽核記錄（如 ISO 9001 第三方稽核）
blocks.en: There is a recent audit record (such as an ISO 9001 third-party audit)

blocks.zh: 廠商提供的資訊缺乏關鍵性（對品質影響風險低）
blocks.en: The information provided by the vendor is not critical (low risk to quality)

blocks.zh: 其他經 QU 核准的有據理由
blocks.en: Other documented justification approved by the QU

blocks.zh: 重新評估的決策同樣基於風險——如果廠商狀況未改變，且初次評估觸發因素依舊成立，則不必重新評估。
blocks.en: The decision to reassess is likewise risk-based: if the vendor's situation has not changed and the triggers for the initial assessment still hold, reassessment is not necessary.

blocks.zh: 💡 思考練習：你的 CDMO 應選哪種策略？
blocks.en: 💡 Exercise: Which Strategy Should Your CDMO Choose?

blocks.zh: 情境 1：你們長期合作 5 年的自動化控制廠商，上次評估在 2 年前，近期沒有重大系統或人員變化。→ 可考慮沿用既有評估或豁免。
blocks.en: Scenario 1: An automation control vendor you have worked with for 5 years; the last assessment was 2 years ago, and there have been no significant system or personnel changes recently. → Consider reusing the existing assessment or a waiver.

blocks.zh: 情境 2：新廠商首次提供無菌充填隔離器，全新設計，無合作歷史。→ 必須考慮SME 現場評估，且不宜豁免。
blocks.en: Scenario 2: A new vendor supplies an aseptic filling isolator for the first time; it is a brand-new design with no history of cooperation. → You must consider an on-site SME assessment, and a waiver is not appropriate.

blocks.zh: 情境 3：廠商提供辦公室空調系統（非 GMP 區域），對產品無影響。→ 可考慮豁免或自我評估。
blocks.en: Scenario 3: A vendor provides an office air conditioning system (non-GMP area) with no impact on product. → Consider a waiver or self-assessment.

blocks.zh: 📋 6 項額外控制措施
blocks.en: 📋 The 6 Additional Controls

blocks.zh: 當廠商不熟悉 GMP 環境時，業主需要採取補強措施。以下是六種工具，可單獨或組合使用：
blocks.en: When a vendor is unfamiliar with the GMP environment, the owner needs to take supplementary measures. The following six tools can be used individually or in combination:

blocks.zh: 🔤 廠商訓練與指導：提供 GDocP、GMP 基礎教育
blocks.en: 🔤 Vendor training and guidance: provide basic education on GDocP and GMP

blocks.zh: 🔍 額外審查與核准：在文件流程中增加 QU 審查點
blocks.en: 🔍 Additional review and approval: add QU review points in the document workflow

blocks.zh: 📋 增加稽核頻率：不只做初次評估，追加定期訪廠
blocks.en: 📋 Increased audit frequency: beyond the initial assessment, add periodic vendor site visits

blocks.zh: 👀 見證關鍵活動：業主 SME 親赴廠商現場見證設計審查、製造、測試
blocks.en: 👀 Witnessing critical activities: the owner's SMEs attend the vendor site to witness design reviews, manufacturing and testing

blocks.zh: 🤝 第三方服務支援：委託顧問公司協助廠商補強 QMS
blocks.en: 🤝 Third-party service support: engage a consulting firm to help the vendor strengthen its QMS

blocks.zh: ✅ 業主自行補測：當廠商文件不可信賴時，業主在現場額外執行測試
blocks.en: ✅ Owner performs supplemental testing: when the vendor's documents cannot be relied upon, the owner performs additional testing on site

blocks.zh: 💡 實務情境：機械工廠 vs. 製藥設備廠
blocks.en: 💡 Practical Scenario: Machine Shop vs. Pharmaceutical Equipment Vendor

blocks.zh: 許多優秀的機械加工廠（如特殊管件、客製化零件廠商）可能只有 ISO 9001 認證，對 GMP、21 CFR Part 11、電子簽名等概念完全陌生。
blocks.en: Many excellent machine shops (such as makers of special fittings or custom parts) may hold only ISO 9001 certification and be completely unfamiliar with concepts such as GMP, 21 CFR Part 11 and electronic signatures.

blocks.zh: 這類廠商仍可被使用，但業主需要：
blocks.en: Such vendors can still be used, but the owner needs to:

blocks.zh: 明確告知他們是在為製藥廠供應
blocks.en: Tell them clearly that they are supplying a pharmaceutical manufacturer

blocks.zh: 提供文件格式範本和 GDocP 說明
blocks.en: Provide document format templates and an explanation of GDocP

blocks.zh: 安排業主 QA 在關鍵製造階段現場見證
blocks.en: Arrange for the owner's QA to witness on site at critical manufacturing stages

blocks.zh: 若文件仍不可靠，業主需自行在安裝後補做測試
blocks.en: If the documents are still unreliable, perform the testing itself after installation

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：缺陷要早發現、早處理，越到後期（如 SAT 時）才發現問題，補救成本越高。
blocks.en: Key principle: find and address defects early. The later a problem is found (for example at SAT), the higher the cost of remediation.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 時程規劃提醒
blocks.en: ⚠️ Schedule Planning Reminder

blocks.zh: 特殊技能訓練（如風險評估引導、SME 審查、密閉空間進入）需要提前規劃時間和資源。若未在專案時程中預留訓練時間，可能導致關鍵里程碑延誤。
blocks.en: Special skills training (such as risk assessment facilitation, SME review, and confined space entry) requires time and resources to be planned in advance. If training time is not allowed for in the project schedule, critical milestones may be delayed.

blocks.zh: 廠商訓練需求應在廠商評估階段就識別，越早安排越好，不應留到廠商已進場後才開始訓練。
blocks.en: Vendor training needs should be identified at the vendor assessment stage; the earlier it is arranged the better, and it should not be left until the vendor is already on site.

blocks.zh: 🏢 CDMO 應用情境
blocks.en: 🏢 CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 委託廠商在廠內進行設備安裝和 SAT，廠商人員會長期駐廠。這時需要特別注意：
blocks.en: If a CDMO engages a vendor to perform equipment installation and SAT in its facility, vendor personnel will be on site for an extended period. In this case, particular attention is needed to the following:

blocks.zh: 廠商人員進入 GMP 區域前必須完成環境衛生與更衣訓練
blocks.en: Vendor personnel must complete environmental hygiene and gowning training before entering GMP areas

blocks.zh: 現場文件（如安裝紀錄）必須符合業主的 GDocP 程序
blocks.en: On-site documents (such as installation records) must comply with the owner's GDocP procedures

blocks.zh: 任何發現的缺陷必須透過業主的偏差管理系統記錄，而非廠商自己的系統
blocks.en: Any defect found must be recorded through the owner's deviation management system, not the vendor's own system

blocks.zh: 保密協議確保智財保護
blocks.en: A confidentiality agreement ensures protection of intellectual property

blocks.zh: 📚 核心概念：Engineering Quality Process 的定位
blocks.en: 📚 Core Concept: Positioning of the Engineering Quality Process

blocks.zh: 製藥品質系統 (PQS) 是組織層級的品質框架，涵蓋所有生產、品質、工程活動。
blocks.en: The Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) is the organization-level quality framework, covering all production, quality and engineering activities.

blocks.zh: 工程品質流程 (Engineering Quality Process) 是 PQS 的子集，專門負責 C&Q 過程中的品質實踐。
blocks.en: The Engineering Quality Process is a subset of the PQS, responsible specifically for quality practices within the C&Q process.

blocks.zh: 製藥品質系統 (PQS)
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS)

blocks.zh: 工程品質流程 (Engineering Quality Process)
blocks.en: Engineering Quality Process

blocks.zh: C&Q 程序、工具、模板
blocks.en: C&Q procedures, tools, templates

blocks.zh: 重要區分：
blocks.en: Important distinction:

blocks.zh: 品質 (Quality) = 產品/服務符合規格要求（Specified Requirements）
blocks.en: Quality = the product/service meets the Specified Requirements

blocks.zh: 合規 (Compliance) = 符合現行程序或組織要求（Procedures）
blocks.en: Compliance = conformance with current procedures or organizational requirements (Procedures)

blocks.zh: 品質良好的流程自然帶來合規；但僅僅合規未必代表品質。ISPE 強調要追求品質本質，而非只追求形式上的合規。
blocks.en: A process of good quality naturally brings compliance, but compliance alone does not necessarily mean quality. ISPE emphasizes pursuing the substance of quality, not merely formal compliance.

blocks.zh: 🌟 ICH Q10 三大目標
blocks.en: 🌟 The Three ICH Q10 Objectives

blocks.zh: ① 產品實現 (Product Realisation)：建立能穩定生產符合規格產品的流程與系統
blocks.en: ① Achieve Product Realisation: establish processes and systems that consistently produce products meeting specifications

blocks.zh: ② 建立並維持控制狀態 (State of Control)：確保系統持續在受控狀態運作
blocks.en: ② Establish and maintain a State of Control: ensure systems continue to operate in a controlled state

blocks.zh: ③ 促進持續改善 (Continual Improvement)：透過變更管理和 CAPA 機制持續優化
blocks.en: ③ Facilitate Continual Improvement: continuously optimize through change management and CAPA mechanisms

blocks.zh: 這三個目標與 C&Q 的核心使命完全一致：確認系統達到預期目的（Product Realisation），並維持在受控狀態（State of Control），並在生命週期中持續改善。
blocks.en: These three objectives are fully consistent with the core mission of C&Q: confirming that a system achieves its intended purpose (Product Realisation), keeping it in a State of Control, and continually improving it throughout the lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 💡 戴明原則 (Deming's Principle) 的深層意義
blocks.en: 💡 The Deeper Meaning of Deming's Principle

blocks.zh: 戴明博士（W. Edwards Deming）是現代品質管理之父，他的核心主張是：
blocks.en: Dr. W. Edwards Deming, the father of modern quality management, held as his core claim:

blocks.zh: 「不要靠篩選找出壞品，要改善流程讓壞品不產生。」
blocks.en: "Do not rely on screening to find defective products; improve the process so that defects are not produced."

blocks.zh: 這個哲學對 C&Q 的啟示是：
blocks.en: The implication for C&Q is:

blocks.zh: 舊思維：設備上線後做大量 IQ/OQ/PQ 測試，測完才知道有沒有問題
blocks.en: Old thinking: after the equipment goes online, run extensive IQ/OQ/PQ testing, and only find out whether there are problems once testing is finished

blocks.zh: 新思維（ISPE Vol.5）：在設計、採購、安裝每個環節就建入品質要求，讓關鍵屬性 (CA) 在最合適的節點被驗證，而不是都堆到最後的 PQ 去
blocks.en: New thinking (ISPE Vol.5): build quality requirements into every step of design, procurement and installation, so that Critical Aspects (CA) are verified at the most appropriate point, instead of all being piled up at the final PQ

blocks.zh: 這正是 ISPE Vol.5 推動 Risk-Based C&Q 的哲學基礎。
blocks.en: This is precisely the philosophical foundation of the Risk-Based C&Q promoted by ISPE Vol.5.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ FDA 2006 質量系統指南的重要性
blocks.en: ⚠️ Importance of the FDA 2006 Quality Systems Guidance

blocks.zh: FDA 2006 年發布的「Quality Systems Approach to Pharmaceutical CGMP Regulations」建立了六系統檢查模型（將在 11.2 節詳述），並明確說明「品質應建入產品，不能單靠測試來保證品質」。這是現代 GMP 的核心哲學，也是 ISPE Vol.5 整個方法論的基礎。
blocks.en: The FDA's 2006 "Quality Systems Approach to Pharmaceutical CGMP Regulations" established the six-system inspection model (detailed in Section 11.2) and stated explicitly that "quality should be built into the product, and testing alone cannot be relied on to assure product quality". This is the core philosophy of modern GMP and the foundation of the entire ISPE Vol.5 methodology.

blocks.zh: 💡 比喻：工具箱 vs. 思維框架
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: Toolbox vs. Mindset Framework

blocks.zh: 本節特別強調，Engineering Quality Process 不應被視為「一堆模板和表格的集合」，而是一種思維框架（Philosophy）。
blocks.en: This section stresses that the Engineering Quality Process should not be seen as "a collection of templates and forms", but as a way of thinking (Philosophy).

blocks.zh: 類比：ISO 9001 不只是一份程序書清單，它是一種品質管理哲學。同樣地，Engineering Quality Process 是一套讓工程師和 QA 共同以「品質建入」為目標協作的思維方式。
blocks.en: Analogy: ISO 9001 is not just a list of procedure manuals; it is a quality management philosophy. Likewise, the Engineering Quality Process is a way of thinking that lets engineers and QA collaborate with "building quality in" as their shared goal.

blocks.zh: 當工程師理解「為什麼要做 CA 識別」，而不只是「要填哪張表」，整個 C&Q 程式的品質才能真正提升。
blocks.en: When engineers understand "why CA identification is done", and not just "which form to fill in", the quality of the whole C&Q program can truly improve.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Engineering Quality Process 的 5 個額外目標
blocks.en: ⚠️ The 5 Additional Objectives of the Engineering Quality Process

blocks.zh: 精實框架（Lean Framework）— 促進創新，減少不必要的工作
blocks.en: Lean Framework: promotes innovation and reduces unnecessary work

blocks.zh: CA↔CDE 追溯機制 — 確保關鍵屬性與關鍵設計要素的可追溯性
blocks.en: CA↔CDE traceability: ensures traceability between Critical Aspects and Critical Design Elements

blocks.zh: 科學與風險導向決策 — 基於知識而非僅填寫通用表格
blocks.en: Science- and risk-based decision making: based on knowledge rather than merely filling in generic forms

blocks.zh: 生命週期知識管理 — 優化工程知識的維護與傳承
blocks.en: Lifecycle knowledge management: optimizes the maintenance and transfer of engineering knowledge

blocks.zh: SME 主導環境 — 重視人員發展，培訓具備執行能力的 SME
blocks.en: SME-led environment: values people development and trains SMEs capable of execution

blocks.zh: 🏢 CDMO 應用：如何建立 Engineering Quality Process 計畫
blocks.en: 🏢 CDMO Application: How to Establish an Engineering Quality Process Program

blocks.zh: 對於快速成長的 CDMO，建立 Engineering Quality Process 的實務步驟：
blocks.en: For a fast-growing CDMO, the practical steps to establish an Engineering Quality Process are:

blocks.zh: Step 1：高層背書 — 需要工程部門和 QA 的高層共同推動，列入公司品質目標
blocks.en: Step 1: Senior management endorsement — senior leaders of Engineering and QA must drive it jointly and include it in the company quality objectives

blocks.zh: Step 2：現狀評估 — 識別目前 C&Q 實踐與理想狀態的差距（Gap Analysis）
blocks.en: Step 2: Current-state assessment — identify the gap between current C&Q practice and the ideal state (Gap Analysis)

blocks.zh: Step 3：利害關係人識別 — 工程、製造、研發、QA、HSE 都是利害關係人
blocks.en: Step 3: Stakeholder identification — Engineering, Manufacturing, R&D, QA and HSE are all stakeholders

blocks.zh: Step 4：角色與職責定義 — 明確誰負責 C&Q Plan、誰核准文件（見 11.4 節）
blocks.en: Step 4: Define roles and responsibilities — make clear who is responsible for the C&Q Plan and who approves documents (see Section 11.4)

blocks.zh: Step 5：建立文件體系 — 政策 → 標準 → SOP → 模板/協議書（見 11.3 節）
blocks.en: Step 5: Establish the document system — policy → standard → SOP → template/protocol (see Section 11.3)

blocks.zh: Step 6：訓練與執行 — 對所有相關人員進行 Engineering Quality Process 訓練
blocks.en: Step 6: Training and execution — train all relevant personnel in the Engineering Quality Process

blocks.zh: Step 7：度量與持續改善 — 建立指標追蹤進度，並透過管理審查持續優化
blocks.en: Step 7: Metrics and continual improvement — establish indicators to track progress, and keep optimizing through management review

blocks.zh: 📋 FDA 六系統稽查模型 (6-System FDA Inspection Model)
blocks.en: 📋 The FDA Six-System Inspection Model (6-System FDA Inspection Model)

blocks.zh: FDA 2006 年指南建立了一個以「品質系統」為基礎，支撐其他五個製造系統的框架：
blocks.en: The FDA 2006 guidance established a framework with the "quality system" as its foundation, supporting the other five manufacturing systems:

blocks.zh: Engineering Quality Process 主要作用於設施與設備系統，但其品質實踐方法影響所有系統。
blocks.en: The Engineering Quality Process acts mainly on the facilities and equipment system, but its quality practices affect all systems.

blocks.zh: 📋 文件層級 (Document Hierarchy) 圖解
blocks.en: 📋 Document Hierarchy Diagram

blocks.zh: Level 1：政策/指令 (Policies/Directives)
blocks.en: Level 1: Policies/Directives

blocks.zh: ↓ 定義期望目標
blocks.en: ↓ Define the expected goals

blocks.zh: Level 2：標準 (Standards)
blocks.en: Level 2: Standards

blocks.zh: ↓ 定義最低交付要求
blocks.en: ↓ Define the minimum deliverable requirements

blocks.zh: Level 3：程序 (Procedures / SOPs)
blocks.en: Level 3: Procedures / SOPs

blocks.zh: ↓ 定義執行步驟
blocks.en: ↓ Define the execution steps

blocks.zh: Level 4：可執行文件 (Executable Documents)
blocks.en: Level 4: Executable Documents

blocks.zh: 可執行文件 = 測試計畫、測試腳本、執行報告、協議書等
blocks.en: Executable documents = test plans, test scripts, execution reports, protocols, etc.

blocks.zh: 💡 比喻：建築規範 vs. 施工圖
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: Building Codes vs. Construction Drawings

blocks.zh: 就像建築業中：
blocks.en: It is just like the construction industry:

blocks.zh: 政策 = 建築法規（你必須蓋一棟安全的建築）
blocks.en: Policy = building law (you must build a safe building)

blocks.zh: 標準 = 結構設計規範（承重牆最少要多厚）
blocks.en: Standard = structural design code (how thick a load-bearing wall must be at a minimum)

blocks.zh: 程序 = 施工作業程序（如何澆鑄混凝土）
blocks.en: Procedure = construction work procedure (how to pour concrete)

blocks.zh: 可執行文件 = 具體的施工圖與檢驗記錄
blocks.en: Executable document = the specific construction drawings and inspection records

blocks.zh: 層級越高越抽象，越低越具體。每個層級都從上一層獲得方向，不能跳層解釋或自行詮釋。
blocks.en: The higher the level, the more abstract; the lower, the more concrete. Each level takes its direction from the one above, and levels cannot be skipped or interpreted independently.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 標準的重要要求：避免例外氾濫
blocks.en: ⚠️ Important Requirement for Standards: Avoid a Proliferation of Exceptions

blocks.zh: 標準應「限制特殊條件」（Limit Special Conditions）——不應讓個別廠區基於偏好做出例外。若需要例外，必須有正式的審查和核准機制。
blocks.en: Standards should "Limit Special Conditions"; individual sites should not make exceptions based on preference. If an exception is needed, there must be a formal review and approval mechanism.

blocks.zh: 這對於多廠區的大型 CDMO 特別重要：不同廠區不應自行詮釋驗證標準，應採用統一的組織標準，並透過「廠區互學習」機制持續改善。
blocks.en: This is especially important for large multi-site CDMOs: sites should not interpret validation standards on their own, but should adopt a single organizational standard and keep improving through a "site-to-site learning" mechanism.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ QU 不需要核准所有文件
blocks.en: ⚠️ The QU Does Not Need to Approve All Documents

blocks.zh: Engineering Quality Process 要明確定義「哪些文件需要 QU 核准」。QU 不需要核准每一份文件——這會造成資源浪費和瓶頸。文件核准要求應與風險等級相對應（參考 Section 6.4 核准矩陣）。
blocks.en: The Engineering Quality Process must clearly define "which documents require QU approval". The QU does not need to approve every document, as that would waste resources and create bottlenecks. Document approval requirements should match the risk level (see the approval matrix in Section 6.4).

blocks.zh: 💡 跨部門協作是成功關鍵
blocks.en: 💡 Cross-Functional Collaboration Is the Key to Success

blocks.zh: Engineering Quality Process 的成功，需要上述五個功能的真正協作，而非各自為政。
blocks.en: The success of the Engineering Quality Process requires genuine collaboration among the five functions above, rather than each working in isolation.

blocks.zh: 常見失敗模式：
blocks.en: Common failure modes:

blocks.zh: 工程部門不讓 QU 早期介入（導致設計問題遲至 OQ 才發現）
blocks.en: Engineering does not let the QU get involved early (so design problems are not discovered until OQ)

blocks.zh: 製造部門未參與 CA 識別（導致確認的系統不符合實際使用需求）
blocks.en: Manufacturing does not take part in CA identification (so the qualified system does not meet actual use needs)

blocks.zh: 技術支援未提供關鍵參數範圍（導致 OQ 測試條件設定錯誤）
blocks.en: Technical support does not provide critical parameter ranges (so OQ test conditions are set incorrectly)

blocks.zh: HSE 被排除在外（導致設備設計安全缺陷）
blocks.en: HSE is excluded (so the equipment design has safety flaws)

blocks.zh: 成功模式：在 C&Q Plan 撰寫階段就召集所有五個功能共同定義範疇、角色、交付文件。
blocks.en: Success pattern: at the C&Q Plan drafting stage, bring all five functions together to define the scope, roles and deliverables jointly.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Technical Support/Research 的特殊角色
blocks.en: ⚠️ The Special Role of Technical Support/Research

blocks.zh: 技術支援/研發部門負責提供「設計基礎研究」（Basis of Design Studies）中確定的關鍵參數範圍。這是 CA/CDE 識別的核心輸入來源。若研發人員未參與 C&Q 過程，驗證測試的合格標準很可能缺乏科學依據。
blocks.en: The technical support/R&D function is responsible for providing the critical parameter ranges established in the "Basis of Design Studies". This is the core input source for CA/CDE identification. If R&D personnel do not take part in the C&Q process, the acceptance criteria for validation testing are likely to lack a scientific basis.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這尤其重要：客戶提供的目標產品概況（TPP）和製程設計空間，必須被轉化為設備資格確認的驗收標準。
blocks.en: This is especially important for a CDMO: the Target Product Profile (TPP) and process design space provided by the client must be translated into acceptance criteria for equipment qualification.

blocks.zh: 💡 複習思考：將本章重點串聯
blocks.en: 💡 Review Exercise: Linking the Key Points of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 回顧 Ch.10 和 Ch.11，試回答以下問題：
blocks.en: Looking back at Ch.10 and Ch.11, try to answer the following questions:

blocks.zh: 為什麼對 C&Q 文件目的進行廠商評估，可以同時達到降低成本和維持品質兩個目標？
blocks.en: Why can vendor assessment for C&Q documentation purposes achieve both lower cost and maintained quality?

blocks.zh: 在決定是否接受廠商文件時，「預期用途」和「廠商 QMS 適用性」分別如何影響決策？
blocks.en: When deciding whether to accept vendor documentation, how do "intended use" and "suitability of the vendor QMS" each affect the decision?

blocks.zh: Engineering Quality Process 的「品質」與「合規」區分，對你日常工作有何啟示？
blocks.en: What does the distinction between "quality" and "compliance" in the Engineering Quality Process mean for your day-to-day work?

blocks.zh: 假設你的組織要從零建立 Engineering Quality Process，最困難的步驟是什麼？如何克服？
blocks.en: Suppose your organization had to build an Engineering Quality Process from scratch: what would be the hardest step, and how would you overcome it?
